original: WPRPLACE, also known as Furebergfossen, is a waterfall in Kvinnherad Municipality, Vestland County. The waterfall is located in Furebergselva, at the mouth of the Maurangerfjord. It is located at the county road 500 which runs from the Eastern Pole in Kvinnherad to Skjersholmane ferjekai on Stord. The waterfall is steep, and has a large drop of about 20 meters before it flows into the Maurangerfjord.
